g.text: Activity — the workshop day (UC30, UC32-UC35, UC40-UC42)
Move the affected jobs to another bay
A technician is off or a bay is down?
(bays as rows, jobs placed by time)
"Has the vehicle arrived?" is the advisor's call
at the desk. The system does not check the date:
a CONFIRMED job can be started on any day, also
before the booked one (open question, code review Q1).
no: the booking must be dropped
the checklist and the customer's note
(parts staff order, receive and issue them)
The advisor can also start it from the board.
Check the bay or technician that changes: active,
right bay type, has the skill, on shift for the whole
job; EXCLUDE has the last word
→ 409; a technician acting on someone else's
